acceptance: Reproduce the exact incident: Antigravity task remains in_progress, two generic_exit records reach the chair threshold, no active worker/queue/lease exists, then Human/Ops records a newer exact-head reviewer reopen; current code never redispatches despite live-ready Antigravity.
Design and implement one bounded progress-aware eligibility/reaper policy in supervisor source; do not add an unconditional counter reset and do not mutate canonical task state.

Permit a same-owner retry only when authoritative task owner is unchanged, status is eligible, a newer governed reviewer reopen/handoff or verified commit/head progress postdates the recorded failure, and there is no active worker, queue event, or worktree lease for the task.

Limit automatic recovery to explicitly classified non-terminal generic_exit or missing_process records. Auth, quota, policy, overlap, dirty-worktree, wrong-branch, wrong-task, and provider-unready failures remain fail-closed.

Consume or bind the recovery to the exact task/provider/progress generation so one reviewer event cannot create an infinite retry loop; a subsequent exit without newer progress must again reach and retain the threshold.
Emit a durable activity audit containing task, logical provider, prior count/kind/timestamp, qualifying progress evidence, decision, and resulting dispatch event; never log secrets.

If an operator recovery interface is added, it must be an exact task plus logical-provider command under runtime_state_lock, fail closed on changed/missing records, preserve all other streaks, and audit before/after. It is not a substitute for the automatic bounded policy.

Add deterministic tests for the incident, newer reviewer reopen, newer commit progress, stale/no progress, changed owner, active worker, pending queue, active lease, provider unavailable, excluded failure kinds, replay of the same recovery generation, and unrelated streak preservation.
Run focused tests plus the full relevant supervisor regression. No live process signals, no direct runtime-state fixture outside temporary test roots, and no config edits.

Supersede stale PR #4385 only after the new clean PR exists and explicitly records why its L12-only missing_process behavior and stale approval cannot be merged as the generic fix; do not reuse its branch or approved SHA.
Use a clean governed task worktree from current origin/dev, branch task/SUP-PROGRESS-AWARE-FAILURE-STREAK-RETRY-20260801, PR target dev, and keep scope to declared artifacts.
Deliver focused commits with LLM-Agent: Antigravity, exact Task-ID, Reviewer: Human/Ops and Verified trailers; wait for all checks and exact-head Human/Ops review before merge.
Rollout is source merge followed by a separate governed supervisor runtime canary after the promotion transaction chain is accepted. Rollback is revert of the merge; no config migration is allowed.
